name: f4-curv-depth-kpi-latent-space
description: DB reader/writer for the F4_CURV_DEPTH_KPI_LATENT_SPACE (F4-alternative) skill: computes the Curvature Depth Index in latent space (CDIh, unweighted and weighted) between a person's own fitted representation h(t) (F2_GDX_SKILL_LATENT_REPRESENTATIONS's own output) and an explicit, frozen reference pinned to the same fitted coordinate system, and records the result into the GDX_HNF_CDIH_* tables, over the Firebird wire protocol (no native client library needed).
